youtube.title: What is ConstructHUB? Business tools and a CRM for contractors
youtube.description: ConstructHUB is two products for contractors. Business tools hold a directory of county and city permit offices, county property records, and tools for your Google listing, reviews and website. The CRM runs the job: pipeline, estimates your client approves online, schedule, job photos, invoices and payments. Each product has its own plans.
